name: Scavenged Goods
summary: Around Deathknell, Forsaken gather Scavenged Goods from equipment boxes. Newly risen undead rely on these discarded supplies to arm and clothe the recruits who follow.

sections.title: Fending for Themselves
sections.body: New Forsaken rise in Deathknell's graveyard with little more than rotting burial shrouds. Nearby settlements and kingdoms offer the undead no aid, so they must salvage what they need. Deathguard Saltain gathers discarded weapons, tools, and garments from supply crates across the village, then gives them to the next recruits to rise.

faq.q: What are scavenged goods used for?
aliases: what does saltain do with scavenged goods
faq.answer: Deathguard Saltain gathers Scavenged Goods to outfit fresh Forsaken rising from the cemetery. Without the supplies in nearby crates, they would enter Tirisfal Glades unarmed and unclad.
The goods are found in equipment boxes outside cottages and around ruined buildings across Deathknell.

faq.q: Who asks for the scavenged goods?
faq.answer: Deathguard Saltain, an officer in Deathknell, asks newly awakened Forsaken to gather the supplies. He teaches them self-reliance and prepares for the recruits who follow.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, you need discarded equipment to survive; the living offer you no aid or mercy.
